newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Cho Hung Bank $180 mln GDR issue priced.
newsitem.headline: Cho Hung Bank $180 mln GDR issue priced.

text.p: South Korea's Cho Hung Bank said on Wednesday its $180 million global depositary receipt issue had been priced at a premium of one percent.
A statement from the bank said the issue price was set at $8.15 per receipt, against the base price of 6,700 won.
The statement said it applied the currency rate of 828.50 won per U.S. dollar.
Payment is scheduled to be completed on December 4.
The bank will issue 22.09 million receipts and list them on the London Stock Exchange, the statement said.
Proceeds from the issue will be used as loans to domestic small to medium-sized firms, it added.
Lead managers are LG Securities, BZW Securities and SBC Securities.
Cho Hung shares ended Wednesday's trading at 6,750 won, unchanged from the previous close.
